# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 27 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f2f2f2);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #1a1a1a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f2f2f2;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f2f2f2 | #1a1a1a | Cards preenchidos, trilhas de progresso, campos desabilitados. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 300 72px/1.05 "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.02em;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 72px / 1.05, letter-spacing -0.02em | 300 | `sans` | Títulos de impacto: capas, heróis, aberturas. Light. |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 56px / 1.05, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `sans` | Título de herói em SemiBold. |
| `h1` | `.h1`, `--text-h1` | 40px / 1.1, letter-spacing -0.01em | 600 | `sans` | Título da página. |

| `eyebrow` | `.eyebrow`, `--text-eyebrow` | 12px / 1.4, letter-spacing 0.08em | 600 | `sans` | Rótulos e tags, em CAIXA ALTA. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Inter_18pt-Light.ttf`, `fonts/Inter_18pt-Regular.ttf`, `fonts/Inter_18pt-Italic.ttf`, `fonts/Inter_18pt-Medium.ttf`, `fonts/Inter_18pt-SemiBold.ttf` and `fonts/Inter_18pt-Bold.ttf` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Inter_18pt-Light.ttf` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Inter_18pt-Light.ttf`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Inter | `fonts/Inter_18pt-Regular.ttf` (weight 400) | `read fonts/Inter_18pt-Regular.ttf` | `var(--font-sans)` | `inter` |

Every face: `fonts/Inter_18pt-Light.ttf` (Inter, 300), `fonts/Inter_18pt-Regular.ttf` (Inter, 400), `fonts/Inter_18pt-Italic.ttf` (Inter, 400, italic), `fonts/Inter_18pt-Medium.ttf` (Inter, 500), `fonts/Inter_18pt-SemiBold.ttf` (Inter, 600), `fonts/Inter_18pt-Bold.ttf` (Inter, 700).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--sp-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--sp-1` | 4px | Ícone e texto; rótulo e sublinha. |
| `--sp-2` | 8px | Entre rótulo e título num card; entre tags. |
| `--sp-3` | 12px | Padding vertical de botões e campos; entre botões. |
| `--sp-4` | 16px | Entre itens de lista e cards pequenos. |
| `--sp-5` | 24px | Padding de cards; gutter do grid. |
| `--sp-6` | 32px | Entre cards lado a lado; padding de cards grandes. |
| `--sp-7` | 48px | Entre o bloco de título e o conteúdo. |
| `--sp-8` | 64px | Entre seções de uma página. |
| `--sp-9` | 96px | Margem lateral no desktop; grandes respiros. |

## Shadow

O sistema não usa sombras: superfícies se separam por cor ou por borda de 1px.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-0: none) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-0), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-0` | none | Tudo. |
